When the form is saved, the postal code is checked for the chosen country (`A1A 1A1` style for Canada, exactly five digits for Germany and the United States) and a bad one shows `Enter a valid postal code for <country>` without saving. Saved addresses are listed, the first one saved is the default, and Set as default makes exactly one address the default, so the previous default loses it; the default survives a reload.
